nodes.name: Recent Sent Mail
nodes.notes: Point this at the Sent Items folder.

parameters.subject: =Stale follow-ups, {{ $now.format("yyyy-LL-dd") }}
parameters.bodyContent: ={{ $json.none ? "Nothing has gone unanswered past the threshold." : $input.all().map(i => "- " + (i.json.to || "unknown") + ", " + i.json.elapsed_days + " days: " + (i.json.subject || "(no subject)")).join("\n") }}

parameters.content:
## Stale follow-up

Threshold is **5 days** and is a placeholder. Confirm the real one.

Thread-aware by conversationId: a reply from anyone on the thread answers it (STL-03).

Output is a draft, not a send.
